newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCCER-VALENCIA SCORE KEY AWAY WIN AGAINST SLAVIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VALENCIA SCORE KEY AWAY WIN AGAINST SLAVIA.

text.p: Valencia, playing without unsettled Brazilian striker Romario, beat Slavia Prague 1-0 on Tuesday in the first leg of their UEFA Cup second round tie.
Slavia, who reached the semifinals of the competition last season, had several early scoring chances, but failed to capitalise on any.
The Spanish side, who knocked holders Bayern Munich out in the previous round, never quite gelled in attack, but defended superbly and went ahead in the 73rd minute.
Striker Carlos Moya found himself unmarked in the penalty area after Goran Vlaovic's shot hit the post, giving Valencia the key away goal.

The match looked a tricky one for Valencia as Slavia are the current Czech champions who played in the preliminary round of the European Cup this season where they were eliminated by Grasshopper Zurich.
Under new rules, clubs eliminated in the preliminary round of Europe's premier club competition now switch to the UEFA Cup for a second bite of the financial rewards on offer.
